name: production-negative-v1
description: R0-02 negative-control set for the *production* retrieval port (IRetrievalPort). Every query is a Chinese natural-language concept whose answer really exists in this repository, but whose literal text shares no token with the identifiers of the answering file — so a lexical/symbol-only pass must miss it. The assertion for these cases is NOT recall (recall is expected to be 0, and that is the measurement): it is claim.kind == None with 'vector' still listed in claim.unsearched, i.e. a lexical-only miss may never be reported as 'it does not exist'. expectedHits records the true answering file so the miss stays visible and machine-checkable.

cases.query: 空结果怎么区分没查过和确实没有
两种写法的路径怎么算成同一个身份
